field_map_precedence.rule: M3 direct field ownership and value provenance
derived implementation values only for Source required fields absent from the M3 header
base_mapping.local_only_fields is an annotation and cannot override a direct M3 field

source_safety_epoch_correction.rule: copy the M3 numeric value verbatim; do not derive, reset, or classify as local-only
source_safety_epoch_correction.base_mapping_annotation: data/mvp-contract-v0/base-mapping.json#/local_only_fields/Source/2 is stale for this bridge and is not authoritative

platform_allowed.source: No M3 column; no platform policy, rate-limit, or compliance evidence is present in the frozen input.
platform_allowed.semantic_guard: unknown remains unknown; this value cannot satisfy the activation gate

source_config_epoch.source: Initial local fixture/provider epoch; no provider switch or epoch increment occurs during M3 seed import.
source_config_epoch.semantic_guard: minimum=1; the bridge never increments or infers a production provider epoch

created_at.source: the canonical date produced by the explicit added_at normalization rule below
created_at.semantic_guard: seed creation time is deterministic and has no wall-clock dependency

updated_at.source: M3 is a creation-only shadow import and contains no update event
updated_at.semantic_guard: updated_at cannot be later than or differ from created_at in this seed

created_by_ref.source: implementation seed actor; no human, platform account, token, or credential is represented
created_by_ref.semantic_guard: matches Source pattern and is local-only

updated_by_ref.source: same creation-only seed event as created_by_ref
updated_by_ref.semantic_guard: matches Source pattern and is local-only

added_at_conflict.source_field_type: M3 datetime transport value formatted as YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
added_at_conflict.recommended_rule: parse exactly YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss, require 00:00:00, and project the calendar date YYYY-MM-DD
added_at_conflict.preservation_semantics: preserve the M3 calendar date; do not claim byte-for-byte preservation of the transport timestamp
forbidden_rules: RFC3339 conversion into the date field
added_at_conflict.accepted_rule: ADR-M4-VS0-SEED-002 inherits ADR-M4-VS0-SEED-001 §2.2: keep the v0.3 Source schema unchanged and treat the M3 timestamp as a transport representation of the M3 date field.
